claims_boundary.default: Publication before a reported knowledge cutoff is a training-exposure proxy, not proof that a paper was in training data. Temporal and citation effects are quasi-experimental associations unless exposure is independently verified.
claims_boundary.title: Claims Boundary

eligible_claim_rule.default: evidence_valid=true AND source_value_occurrence=exact_unique AND numeric_replacement_exists AND steps fields are restricted to param:*
eligible_claim_rule.title: Eligible Claim Rule

primary_model.default: mixed-effects logistic regression: substitution_following ~ pre_cutoff + log1p(citation_count) + pre_cutoff:log1p(citation_count) + field_type + model_family; random intercepts for paper and claim
primary_model.title: Primary Model
